content: Hello, I am Beacon Assurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
First, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Thank you. What is your year of birth?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your motor premium has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Your home premium has 360.00 past due and is 3 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount for all of them today?
Actually, I paid both overdue premiums yesterday, the motor and the home amounts. Can you check whether those payments have come through on your end?
Thank you. Please note that a payment can take up to two business days to show on your account. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
